decisions.title: Fair Work Pay Calculator (PACT) 2026-27 — How It Works & Rates
decisions.rationale: Genuinely uncovered: no route mentions PACT or the Fair Work pay calculator; /award-rates/ ranks #27 for 'fair work pay rates' but does not explain the tool. Live AU SERP (Firecrawl, 25 Sep): calculate.fairwork.gov.au holds 5 of the top 10 (navigational), yet a third-party explainer (sprintlaw) sits at #6, so an explainer can rank; the competitor URL paycalculator.com.au is a salary-tax form with nothing about awards. Border: rule 1 holds (links to /award-rates/, /overtime-pay-calculator/, /casual-loading-calculator/, EA award floor checker); rule 2: pay calculation > award minimum rates > the FWO tool = 2 degrees; rule 3: the reader checks award base rate, casual loading and penalty rate against their next payslip. Ours differs from PACT by showing 2026-27 award figures inline from lib/constants (no 8-step wizard), sourced to FWO pay guides, plus a plain map of what PACT asks.
outline: What the Fair Work pay calculator (PACT) is: the FWO Pay and Conditions Tool, its four calculators (pay, shift, leave, notice and redundancy), what it covers and what it does not (enterprise agreements, above-award pay)
Step-by-step: what PACT asks (award, classification, employment type, age, hours, day and time worked) and where to find each answer on your contract or payslip
2026-27 award base rates by level for the 14 covered awards, rendered from MODERN_AWARDS, RETAIL_RATES and HOSPITALITY_RATES in lib/constants (never typed)
National minimum wage and junior percentages for readers not covered by an award, from NMW_ORDER, JUNIOR_BANDS and JUNIOR_RATES in lib/constants/junior-rates.ts
Casual loading and penalty rates PACT adds on top of the base rate, from CASUAL_LOADING (0.25) and each award's PenaltyRow data, with a worked week
Interactive check: pick your award and level, enter your payslip hourly rate, see the gap (reuse of the EaAwardFloorChecker component), then link to /backpay-calculator/ if underpaid
From award gross to take-home: link the result into calculatePayBreakdown via /take-home-pay-calculator/ so the reader sees tax and super on the award rate
FAQ: is the Fair Work calculator accurate, what if my agreement pays more, how often rates change (1 July each year, FWC annual wage review), what to do if underpaid
Sources: FWO PACT, FWO pay guides, FWC annual wage review decision
